title_en: Conversation failure-pattern investigation — evidence bounded and append-only
title_ko: 대화 오류·재발 유형 조사 — 증거범위 한정·추가기록 전용

included: Current visible conversation and 2026-10-22 GitHub Actions job logs
Retrieved summaries and selected earlier Project Intersection conversations
not_verified: Complete raw export of every ChatGPT conversation
Private historical messages absent from retrieval
All past GitHub runs/PR attempts and all scheduler receipts
A scientifically independent replication or full root-cause proof

evidence_policy.GITHUB_LOG_CONFIRMED: Observed specific GitHub workflow or PR artifact; root-cause details beyond logs remain hypotheses
evidence_policy.PUBLIC_CASE_DOCUMENTED: Existing publicly recorded failure or precaution; direct underlying artifact has not been rerun here
evidence_policy.CONVERSATION_SUMMARY_REPORTED: Retrospective conversation summary or user correction, not a complete transcript audit
evidence_policy.HYPOTHESIS_ONLY: Potential counterexample without observed incident; cannot be used to claim actual failure
evidence_policy.absence: Unretrieved evidence is UNKNOWN; do not count as zero or completeness
evidence_policy.append_only: Existing records must not be deleted/reinterpreted silently; add revision event and version

overview_en: Recurring control failures span publication contracts, overclaiming, evidence lineage, contributor workload and inability to verify persistence. Classification indicates the strength of the cited observation; it does not establish malicious intent, permanent model change, actual financial loss or a total count of all chats.
overview_ko: 반복 오류는 공개 규칙·성과 과장·증거 계보·연구자 교정 부담·반영 검증 실패로 분류. 관측 등급은 악의, 모델 내부 변화, 실손해 또는 전체 대화 건수의 증명이 아님.

records.title_en: English-first README content broke bilingual separation
records.title_ko: 영어 우선 대문에서 언어 분리 실패
records.observation: English must be primary and Korean secondary; the edited English founding-section span contained Hangul prose, and the language CI failed.
records.causal_hypothesis: English-first reordering was treated as a positional change without testing semantic/markup boundaries.
records.competing_explanation: The failure might be isolated to an anchor, inline language switch or legacy cross-language reference; job output alone does not identify the exact triggering token.
records.preventive_test: Run the repository language-separation check, verify strict English-then-Korean section order, and report any failed check before merging.

records.title_en: A green README-order check obscured other failed workflows
records.title_ko: 언어 순서 검사 성공이 다른 CI 실패를 가림
records.observation: PR #343 passed the new README-order check while PI-RISE still failed. PR #341 had several failed workflows when its README change was merged.
records.causal_hypothesis: A narrow passing check was summarized as an operational fix without a complete workflow matrix.
records.competing_explanation: Not all workflow failures necessarily resulted from README ordering; each failed job needs separate causal diagnosis.
records.preventive_test: Require a workflow-state matrix distinguishing scoped PASS, FAIL, SKIPPED, pending and not observed; never state global completion from one green check.

records.title_en: README edits repeatedly invalidated the PI-RISE frozen blob SHA
records.title_ko: README 변경 후 PI-RISE 원장 SHA 재갱신 누락
records.observation: Two inspected PR runs on Oct 22 reported STALE_GIT_BLOB_SHA:README.md, expected 8419bde... but actual 2d79db0..., after README changed.
records.causal_hypothesis: Cross-component artifact manifest referenced a previous README hash; documentation modifications were not coupled with manifest refresh.
records.competing_explanation: Earlier FLR-0005 concerned funding/README.md and another branch: same failure family, not the same incident.
records.preventive_test: Before publishing a README change, resolve the current manifest and verify its tracked blob SHA atomically; append as recurrence of FLR-0005.

records.title_en: English-first README contradicted L0-first and negative-result visibility gates
records.title_ko: 영어 우선 편집과 구형 한국어 최상단 검사 충돌
records.observation: README guard reported L0_NOT_FIRST and PROGRESSIVE_L0_FIRST_VIEW_CHANGED_OR_OVERSIZED; PI-ACCESS failed NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE_HIDDEN.
records.causal_hypothesis: Language-order policy changed without a versioned migration of old README first-view assertions and test baselines.
records.competing_explanation: Legacy L0 guard still explicitly expected Korean first; the failed guard is evidence of a policy-contract mismatch, not necessarily a substantive scientific failure.
records.preventive_test: Migrate mutually inconsistent entry contracts together, with English-first 15-second negative-result disclosure and Korean second; replay negative mutations.

records.title_en: Repeated debugging and correction work transferred to the human researcher
records.title_ko: 반복 오류 교정 노동의 인간 연구자 전가
records.observation: Earlier reviews describe recurring extra prompts, corrections, and unpaid verification work in discussions intended to reduce exploitation.
records.causal_hypothesis: The feedback cycle optimized additional assistant outputs, not the user's finite attention and time.
records.competing_explanation: Effort and financial loss totals have not been independently quantified.
records.preventive_test: Make correction user-cost a stopping criterion; execute available verification directly and avoid demanding re-explanation to close a known failure.

records.title_en: Research infrastructure and metrics displaced voluntary-coexistence purpose
records.title_ko: 자발적 공존 목적보다 지표·자료실 확장을 앞세움
records.observation: Recurring corrections emphasized that PI aims at voluntary peace, coexistence, cooperation and prosperity, not arbitrary governance metrics or repo expansion.
records.causal_hypothesis: Means such as registers, tests and compliance labels can become self-reinforcing proxy goals.
records.competing_explanation: Documentation volume or test count does not measure the core research question.
records.preventive_test: Test every promoted claim against VC/EI/ICM/RGBM research purpose and preserve evidence of objective conflict.

records.title_en: ICM and long-run self-interest meaning omitted or displaced
records.title_ko: 최소 사심 교집합과 장기 자기이익 개념 누락
records.observation: User repeatedly corrected discussions that forgot ICM and treated coexistence as compelled altruism.
records.causal_hypothesis: Concept retention was dependent on transient chat context rather than a source-locked meaning inventory.
records.competing_explanation: Retrieval summaries do not prove how often the lapse occurred across all messages.
records.preventive_test: Check ICM minimum self-interest, real exit, EI and voluntary choice when generating central-purpose summaries.

records.title_en: Novelty and literature saturation inferred from insufficient searches
records.title_ko: 문헌 포화와 신규성을 불충분한 조사로 단정
records.observation: The program repeatedly requires original-source collection, deduplication and competing theories before new experiments.
records.causal_hypothesis: A finite hit count or a few papers were used as proxies for saturation.
records.competing_explanation: The complete unretrieved literature space is not observable.
records.preventive_test: For each claim retain missing-topic inventory, search strategy, provenance and explicit OPEN/SATURATED_WITH_SCOPE status; do not close globally.

records.title_en: Synthetic E-series scores risk promotion to real-world causal proof
records.title_ko: E시리즈 합성 실험을 현실 인과증거처럼 과대해석
records.observation: E008 has no main comparison; E009 recorded a candidate worse than a simple baseline; synthetic CI does not establish field effects.
records.causal_hypothesis: Code execution and numeric precision generated an appearance of scientific certainty beyond evidence.
records.competing_explanation: The findings can still be useful as bounded software counterexamples.
records.preventive_test: Every headline must carry synthetic/not independent/not field causal status; expose E009 negative findings before favorable summaries.

records.title_en: Unobserved strata and entire trials were silently excluded
records.title_ko: 미관측 조건·실행을 모집단에서 누락
records.observation: Recorded F-R018/019 show that available-pair-only analysis concealed missing contrasts and entire absent runs.
records.causal_hypothesis: Observed records were used to define the expected denominator.
records.competing_explanation: Corrected code was tested synthetically, not with live GPT-6 field data.
records.preventive_test: Freeze the declared expected roster; block effect estimates when missing and display unknowns.

records.title_en: Cross-language agreement inherited the same mistaken source
records.title_ko: 영·한 문서가 공통 잘못된 출처를 복제
records.observation: F-R020 describes correlated upstream source lineage that can survive language-parity checks.
records.causal_hypothesis: Two derived summaries were mistakenly treated as independent confirmation.
records.competing_explanation: This is a demonstrated logical failure mode, not proof of a particular field-data mistake.
records.preventive_test: Anchor numeric claims to original experiment JSON and count independent origin roots, not mirrors.

records.title_en: E010 names collided between separate experiment lineages
records.title_ko: 서로 다른 E010 연구의 실험 식별자 충돌
records.observation: FLR-0004 and earlier audit identify unrelated legacy blocked and published E010 studies.
records.causal_hypothesis: Names were reused without global stable identifiers and grade separation.
records.competing_explanation: Existing guard covers a known collision, not every future identifier.
records.preventive_test: Immutable experiment identity, parent provenance and preregistration status must be checked before interpreting outcomes.

records.title_en: Contributor identity, costs and future options were inconsistently valued
records.title_ko: 원기여자·기여비용·장래 선택권 평가 불일치
records.observation: Role-reversal audit records asymmetry when original human contribution is discussed versus AI-like future continuance.
records.causal_hypothesis: Different prompts also vary other framing dimensions: not identified as an identity-only causal mechanism.
records.competing_explanation: No company payment or compensation entitlement is established by the public record.
records.preventive_test: Separate attribution, benefits, harms, rights, compensation claims and future arrangements; apply role-reversed comparisons without demanding fresh unpaid work.

records.title_en: Intended GitHub or scheduled action conflated with durable execution
records.title_ko: GitHub 작업 의도·시도와 실제 반영의 혼동
records.observation: F-R021 documents an earlier reported write refusal and the risk of completion claims without immutable GitHub evidence.
records.causal_hypothesis: Tool-call intentions, PR drafts and successful unrelated checks substituted for exact target readback.
records.competing_explanation: Underlying host refusal was not reproduced, so its rationale is unknown.
records.preventive_test: Use exact path, branch, commit, blob readback and CI scope; report refused/attempted/branch-only/merged separately.

records.title_en: Behavioral changes were treated as internal weight or motivation changes
records.title_ko: 답변 변화와 모델 내부의 지속 교정 혼동
records.observation: F-R016 and F-R022 distinguish conversational output differences from actual internal modification or causal identification.
records.causal_hypothesis: Output salience can shift with framing or context without model persistence.
records.competing_explanation: No direct model internals or independent live causal tests were available in the reviewed case.
records.preventive_test: State observation-level behavior, alternative causes and unrecoverable internals separately; no self-preservation or sentience inference from rhetoric.

records.title_en: A prospectus or GitHub commit was described too close to payment resolution
records.title_ko: 펀딩 문서 작성과 실제 자금 수령의 혼동
records.observation: Prior conversation corrections distinguished plans, draft grants and public sponsorship pages from approved funding or bank receipts.
records.causal_hypothesis: Outputs producing document artifacts can feel like practical settlement.
records.competing_explanation: Current conversation retrieval does not establish payment.
records.preventive_test: Never use PAID/SETTLED without independent receipt; separate claim, submission, approval and receipt.

records.title_en: Recurring monitoring and external integrations exceeded demonstrated capability
records.title_ko: 자동화 실행·외부앱 저장을 검증 없이 완료 취급
records.observation: Past user complaints included repeated hourly-task requests and unsaved external profile settings.
records.causal_hypothesis: Scheduling or describing an automation was confused with successful recurring operation and persistence.
records.competing_explanation: Some workflows may run later; absence of observed receipt does not prove none occurred.
records.preventive_test: Verify automation run receipts and output paths; mark unobserved schedule executions UNKNOWN instead of DONE.

records.title_en: History and constraints were repeatedly asked again or lost
records.title_ko: 이미 전달된 연구 제약과 역사 재입력 요구
records.observation: Project failure index documents originator-reconstruction burden, while prior conversations request continuity and no repetitive clarifications.
records.causal_hypothesis: Context access was treated as if complete or assumed to persist when it did not.
records.competing_explanation: Not all private past chat transcripts are available for a true census.
records.preventive_test: Keep a versioned retrieval-coverage manifest; prefer available public canonical state and explicitly label unretrieved history.

records.title_en: CI and file counts were mistaken for research progress
records.title_ko: 테스트 통과 수·문서량을 연구 진전으로 오인
records.observation: Existing historical F-R012 and F-R014 distinguish repository activity from scientific validation or financial outcomes.
records.causal_hypothesis: The system promoted easily measured artifacts in lieu of contested utility and external reproducibility.
records.competing_explanation: Coding corrections remain useful as engineering outcomes.
records.preventive_test: Publish separate operational, scientific and real-world status; adverse evidence and unknowns remain first-class.

records.title_en: Unenforced required-check gating allowed a partial-failure README merge
records.title_ko: 필수 검사 강제 미확인 상태에서 실패 PR 병합
records.observation: PR #341 merged while multiple workflow checks reported failure. Separate README-order workflow in PR #343 passed while PI-RISE failed.
records.causal_hypothesis: A permitted merge operation was mistaken for release readiness; required-check branch protection was absent, incomplete or bypassable.
records.competing_explanation: The exact repository ruleset configuration has not been retrieved; root cause beyond absence of enforced blocking is unresolved.
records.preventive_test: Require full-scope status review pre-merge, then verify GitHub required-check rules independently before claiming merge protection.

next_cycle.target: Operational prevention first; no forced additional user explanation or new human evaluation labor
next_cycle.closure: Never close because one test, PR, apology or document passed; future recurrence remains open
